title: volcano-detectability: open-data geodetic detectability of Holocene volcanoes (GNSS, Sentinel-1)
description: For every Smithsonian GVP Holocene volcano, the smallest volume change of a source at 2, 5 and 10 km depth that open GNSS (Nevada Geodetic Laboratory, network matched filter at signal-to-noise 5 on seasonally cleaned 30-day means) and open Sentinel-1 coherence (5.9 cm, coherent-area rule) would detect; threat, exposure and country-stratified statistics; national-network classes; an interactive globe atlas; all derived tables, figures and unit tests. Measures what open data can see, not what observatories see. Retrospective sensitivity only; no forecasts.
